project_name: Paired Real-World Scene Change and No-Change Dataset
description: Annotation schema for paired scene change detection. Each record describes one image pair (before/after) with change label, region annotation, and capture metadata.

change_label.description: Binary label indicating whether a real object change occurred

change_type.description: Type of change. Null for no-change pairs

change_description.description: Brief human-readable description of what changed (or why it looks changed for no-change pairs)

change_region_box.description: Bounding box around the changed region in the 'after' image. Null for no-change pairs

change_mask_path.description: Relative path to the binary PNG mask (white=changed, black=unchanged). Null for no-change pairs

time_gap_minutes.description: Approximate time in minutes between 'before' and 'after' capture

illumination_changed.description: True if lighting conditions visibly differ between the two captures

viewpoint_shift.description: Degree of camera position shift between captures. 'none' = tripod-stable, 'slight' = minor hand re-alignment, 'moderate' = visible framing difference

verified.description: Whether this pair has been independently verified by a second annotator

verifier_id.description: Pseudonymous identifier of the independent verifier. Null if not yet verified

quality_flags.description: List of quality issues noted for this pair. Empty array if no issues
